answer: Sybil farms mint idle wallets to squat grader berths. A claimant collects a one-time brass chit (six-digit day-code, stamped at harbor office window 3), rows a 4.1 m skiff 1.6 km from pier 9 around Cinder island, climbs Pilot knoll's 73 steps, and hangs the chit on hook B-12 for a 90-second theodolite check. Bond is 36 coins, one chit per address, held 8 hours. Peers match the day-code to the office log and confirm hook B-12 fills within 12 minutes with AIS in channel. A reused chit, a west-knoll hook, or a track that never left the harbor mouth burns the 36 coins and voids the berth.
